reported.title: Serial prefix is 'temp=' not 'Temp: '
reported.description: printTemp() at lines 34-35 emits "temp=" followed by the value, so no line ever matches the required `Temp: <celsius>` format. The measured evidence confirms this: "No serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s" across all scenarios, including the nominal ramp where the sensor is fine. No serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Temperature value cannot be parsed from serial output
reported.description: Because printTemp() at lines 34-35 prints "temp=" instead of "Temp: ", the value-matching pattern never matches, so the printed temperature can never be compared to the probe. The measured evidence states "No serial line matched /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A0" in every scenario. No serial line matched /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A0.

reported.title: Range lamp driven by raw instantaneous value with no hysteresis
reported.description: updateRangeLamp() at lines 26-30 compares the instantaneous report against the thresholds with no hysteresis, so noise near the boundary toggles D7 rapidly; measured "D7 was in the wrong state for 2793 ms across 1086 interval(s)" in the 50 C chatter scenario. Additionally, while frozen the lamp follows the drifting frozenC (lines 57-58), producing wrong lamp state during hold as seen in "freeze at out-of-range then release" (4361 ms wrong). D7 was in the wrong state for 2793 ms across 1086 interval(s), first at 500 ms: D7 was not LOW for 2 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

exposing_checks.behaviour: serial lines matching '^Temp: ' every 1000 ms (Temp: lines)
serial values for 'Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 1.5) (Value OK)

judge_input.spec:
- TMP36 on A0 (10 mV/°C with 500 mV offset); freeze button on D5 (pull-up); range lamp on D7.
- Every 1000 ms print exactly `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon and one decimal place.
- Printed temperature must stay within ±1.5 °C of the injected probe value.
- While D5 is held LOW, freeze the reported value at the last sample.
- Light D7 when the reported temperature is outside -10.0 to 50.0 °C.
- Also print `weather n=<samples>` each second after the Temp line.
